description: Implementation of the QuicCompressedCertsCache class, managing a cache of compressed certificates for QUIC protocol, including hash computation, cache lookup, and insertion methods.

classes.name: QuicCompressedCertsCache
classes.description: A cache for storing compressed certificates associated with uncompressed certs, with methods for retrieval, insertion, and cache size management.

methods.name: GetCompressedCert
methods.description: Retrieves a compressed certificate from the cache matching the given chain and cert hashes.

methods.name: Insert
methods.description: Inserts a new compressed certificate into the cache associated with the given chain and cert hashes.

methods.name: MaxSize
methods.description: Returns the maximum size of the cache.

methods.name: Size
methods.description: Returns the current size of the cache.

classes.name: UncompressedCerts
classes.description: Represents uncompressed certificate data including chain and associated hashes.

classes.name: CachedCerts
classes.description: Represents cached compressed certificate data, including the chain, hashes, and compressed cert.

methods.name: ComputeUncompressedCertsHash
methods.description: Computes a hash value for the uncompressed certs based on the cert hashes and chain pointer.
